author: attome-service (release-check repair)
description: The Queue Claim-To-Resolve report averages per queue: 0040 shipped it without its GROUP BY, so PostgreSQL refused it.
name: attome-service-queue-claim-report

definition.name: Queue Claim-To-Resolve, Minutes (Last 30 Days)
definition.sql: SELECT work_queue_ref AS queue_ref, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - claimed_at)) / 60.0) AS value FROM service_ticket WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND work_queue_ref IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY work_queue_ref

title: Platform definitions: attome-service-queue-claim-report
